summary: Upgrades better-auth 1.6 to 1.7.14 and adds nullable session.impersonatedBy column; without it better-auth 1.7 fails every /api/auth request.

statements.why: Additive nullable column plus dependency bump; the migration risk is covered by the steps.

statements.text: Sessions now also store the impersonated by.
Apply prisma/migrations/20261029000000_session_impersonated_by before the new code goes live, or the parts that use it will fail.
statements.why: Understated: without the column every /api/auth request fails, so nobody can sign in.

statements.text: Test anything that uses better-auth: upgraded from ^1.6.22 to ^1.7.14.
statements.why: package.json bump; login is handled by better-auth.

misses.what: better-auth is the whole-app login system; if code deploys before the migration, every sign-in/session request fails.
